verdict.rationale: Docs mention agents can be run step-by-step and memory can be replayed or modified via step callbacks, which could support manual resumption of long-running or interrupted runs, but there is no documented mechanism for automatically checkpointing agent state to resume exactly after a crash or restart. missing for 10: explicit crash-recovery/checkpoint API, persistence of agent memory across process restarts, and any first-party or community confirmation of resume-after-crash behavior.
